9.18
̓Αποστραφήτωσαν οἱ ἁμαρτωλοὶ εἰς τὸν ᾳ δην, πάντα τὰ ε θνη τὰ ἐπιλαν θανόμενα
τοῦ Θεοῦ. ̓Αποστρέφονται οἱ ἁμαρτωλοὶ εἰς τὸν ᾳ δην, ι να ι δωσιν τὴν ̓Ιησοῦ
ψυχὴν καταβαί νουσαν καὶ ἀναβαίνουσαν. Οἱ γὰρ προσδο κήσαντες αὐτὴν ὡσπερεὶ
ε ξω ε βλεπον, πρῶ τον μὲν οἱ ἐν ἡμῖν ἁμαρτωλοὶ, ει τα τὰ ε θνη. –Τί ἐπελάθετο τὰ
ε θνη τὸν Κύριον; ἡ γὰρ λήθη δευτέρα γνώσεως· οὐκοῦν ἐντεῦθεν σαφὲς καὶ τό·
̓Εγὼ ἐφύτευσά σε α μπελον καρποφόρον, πᾶσαν ἀληθινήν· Πῶς ἐστρά φης εἰς
πικρίαν, ἡ α μπελος ἡ ἀλλοτρία;
pass_a_gloss: Let-be-turned-back the sinners into the Hades, all the nations the ones-forgetting of-the God. Are-turned-back the sinners into the Hades, in-order-that they-might-see the of-Jesus soul descending and ascending. For the ones-having-expected it as-it-were outside were-looking, first on-the-one-hand the in us sinners, then the nations. Why forgot the nations the Lord? for the forgetfulness second of-knowledge; therefore from-here clear also the: I planted you vine fruit-bearing, all true; How were-you-turned into bitterness, the vine the alien?
pass_b_english: “Let sinners be turned back into Hades, all the nations that forget God” (Psalm 9:18).

Sinners are turned back into Hades, so that they might see the soul of Jesus descending and ascending. For those who expected it were looking as it were outside, first the sinners in us, then the nations.

Why did the nations forget the Lord? For forgetfulness is second to knowledge; therefore from this also is clear: “I planted you a fruit-bearing vine, all true; How did you turn into bitterness, the alien vine?” (Jeremiah 2:21).

choices.term: ἵνα ἴδωσιν τὴν Ἰησοῦ ψυχὴν καταβαίνουσαν καὶ ἀναβαίνουσαν
choices.english: so that they might see the soul of Jesus descending and ascending
choices.why: Purpose of the turning into Hades is to see Christ’s descent and ascent, not mere damnation.

so that Jesus might stay in Hades
